scope: Scoped recovery readback and conservative admission for the existing supported security type. No additional automated password-guessing protocols.
implementation: Capture bounded flags and section identities before wireless changes; no credentials retained in recovery snapshot.
Read UCI stable section names using -X; compare owned temporary section absence and exact original device/disabled values.
After the existing reload, read wireless and network runtime once: check owned temporary objects disappeared, affected radios settled, and original running interface sections exist.
Do not guess successful recovery on command success, unreadable output, missing baseline, pending status or mismatched flags.
No timer, retry loop, extra reload or router restart introduced.
Restore reads ignore the cancelled task token so cleanup can still be verified; snapshot is released on exit.
Diagnostics contain fixed reasons only, not raw command output or credentials.
Reject unsupported or ambiguous security before radio preparation; existing explicit WPA2 personal and WPA2 side of mixed mode retained.

compatibility.netifd: 50 exact release component records and old C/new deployed ucode contracts reviewed in the preceding audit.
compatibility.model_behavior: Uses observed radio/interface ownership and original state; no model-specific radio assumptions or unconditional hardware compatibility claim.

validation.skip_reason: Existing POSIX batch test requires Debian environment on this Windows host.
validation.generated_restore_command_executed: Real local Git Bash: healthy state, remaining temporary section, wrong device, unexpected disabled flag, unreadable config.

limits: Recovery verifies saved state and exposed interface runtime, not Internet reachability or every upstream association.
If wireless is still starting at readback, recovery remains explicitly unconfirmed; no forced retry or reload.
New security protocols were not added to multi-target automated password guessing.
